career_ladder.note: Custodial security and emergency response cadre under the Uttar Pradesh Prison Administration and Reform Department (Karagar Prashasan Evam Sudhar Vibhag) and Fire Service Department. Recruits enter at Level 3 and advance through departmental quotas, promotional tests, and seniority.

exam_scheme.note: Selection process comprises an Objective Written Examination (OMR mode) of 300 marks (150 questions of 2 marks each with 0.5 marks negative penalty per wrong answer), followed by Document Verification & Physical Standard Test (DV/PST) and Physical Efficiency Test (PET).

financial_package.note: Jail Warders and Firemen in Uttar Pradesh are placed in Pay Level 3 (Pay Band ₹5,200–₹20,200 with Grade Pay ₹2,000) under the Uttar Pradesh Revised Pay Rules, 2016. Personnel receive DA, HRA, risk allowance, and diet subsidies.
financial_package.pay_source_label: UP Revised Pay Rules 2016 Level 3 & Advt. PRPB-1(Jail/Fireman)-2018
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 3 entry basic pay of ₹21,700 with 58% DA (₹12,586), HRA (₹1,200 to ₹3,600 based on jail location), prison duty risk allowance, uniform allowance, net of 10% NPS deduction (₹3,429) and GIS.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised bi-annually per UP government finance orders
House Rent Allowance (HRA) or official quarters inside prison administrative complexes
Ration subsidy and diet allowance for custodial security personnel
Annual Uniform and Kit Maintenance Allowance
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% matching contribution
Medical facility under UP Government Servants Medical Attendance Rules
